deals.title: Criterion Collection 50% off at Barnes & Noble (4K UHD included)
deals.detail: Criterion confirms all in-stock Criterion discs are 50% off online and in stores through Dec 6, preorders releasing during the sale included. Reported 4K sale prices: Blue Velvet, Mulholland Drive and The Silence of the Lambs $24.99, Harold and Maude $25, Seven Samurai $29.99, The Complete Kubrick 4K $299.99. Amazon is price-matching many Criterion 4Ks (see the entries below).

deals.title: Seven Samurai (Criterion 4K UHD)
deals.detail: $29.99 in 4K, posted Nov 6; Barnes & Noble has the same $29.99 price. One commenter couldn't get the price at Amazon, so B&N is the safer bet.
